**The first fork is at `yadN`**, column 1, carried by 58%. Columns 1 to 7, `yadN` to `yadC`, are [[fimbrial proteins and chaperones]], carried by 27 to 58%, the most plastic stretch of the window.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 74%, and hesitates less there, 0.15 against 0.43 bits. It hesitates most at column 3, `htrE`, a fork column, 1.27 bits.

**Across the window it names 91% of genes**, 0.20 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.89 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 43% against 96%.

label: folK
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the folK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor folK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,572 to 3,651 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying folK once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,091 calls, named 97%, 0.12 bits; shell 4,811 calls, named 50%, 0.81 bits; cloud 298 calls, named 7%, 1.75 bits. Outside an RGP 39,404 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 3,796 calls, named 43%, 0.89 bits. Columns: 65 spine, 9 fork, 6 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.89 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (43% against 96%); 3,796 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (htrE, a fork column) 1.27 bits, RGP 84%; column 1 (yadN, a fork column) 1.03 bits, RGP 84%; column 2 (yadV, a fork column) 0.58 bits, RGP 84%. The 7 columns (columns 1-7) where most calls are in an RGP: named 51%, 0.67 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 95%, 0.16 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 65 spine columns: named 95%, 0.15 bits on average; the 15 fork and variable columns: named 74%, 0.43 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 3, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-7 (fork and variable columns), RGP 59-84%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: folK. named 99.6%; 0.20 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-7 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: share 27-58%, all S, RGP 59-84%. named 19-66% (mean 51%), fewest named at column 4, named 19%; most hesitant at column 3, 1.27 bits.
[S2.c1]    1 fork: yadN S 58% "fimbrial protein"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 25%, yadN (another family) S 14%
[S2.c2]    2 fork: yadV S 57% "fimbrial chaperone"; also yadV (another family) S 14%
[S2.c3]    3 fork: htrE S 49%; also htrE (another family) S 13%
[S2.c4]    4 variable: yadM S 35% "fimbrial protein"
[S2.c5]    5 variable: yadL S 35% "fimbrial-like protein YadL"
[S2.c6]    6 variable: yadK S 48% "fimbrial-like protein"
[S2.c7]    7 fork: yadC S 27% "fimbrial tip-adhesin YadC"; also "fimbrial-like adhesin" S 11%
[S3] 3. columns 8-64 (57 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-11%. Genes: panB, panC "pantoate--beta-alanine ligase", rpnC, panD, yadE "polysaccharide deacetylase family p…", yadI "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA", yadH "ABC transporter permease", yadG "ABC transporter ATP-binding protein", can, hpt, gcd, cueO, yacC "YacC family pilotin-like protein", speE "polyamine aminopropyltransferase", speD, yacL "protein YacL", acnB, yacH "DUF3300 domain-containing protein", lpdA, aceF "pyruvate dehydrogenase complex dihy…", aceE, pdhR, aroP, ampE, ampD "1,6-anhydro-N-acetylmuramyl-L-alani…", nadC, ppdD, gspE, hofC, guaC, "protein YacM", coaE, zapD, yacG "DNA gyrase inhibitor YacG", mutT, secA, secM "secA translation cis-regulator SecM", lpxC, ftsZ "cell division protein FtsZ", ftsA, ftsQ, ddlB, murC "UDP-N-acetylmuramate--L-alanine lig…", murG, ftsW, murD, mraY, murF "UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-tripeptide--D-…", murE, ftsI, ftsL "cell division protein FtsL", rsmH, mraZ, cra, fruR, ilvN "acetolactate synthase small subunit", ilvI. named 58-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 53 (murD), named 58%; most hesitant at column 10 (rpnC), 0.57 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 65-66 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: share 63-90%, 1 S, 1 P, RGP 0.2%. named 89-95% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 65, named 89%; most hesitant at column 66, 0.37 bits.
[S4.c65]    65 fork: "protein YabR" S 63%; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%
[S4.c66]    66 variable: leuO P 90%
[S5] 5. columns 67-71 (5 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 0.2-3%. Genes: leuL, leuA, leuB, leuC "3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large…", leuD. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 71 (leuD), named 95%; most hesitant at column 67 (leuL), 0.32 bits.
[S6] 6. column 72 variable: share 59%, all S, RGP 3%. named 94%; 0.34 bits.

[S7] 7. columns 73-74 (2 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 3-4%. Genes: sgrT "glucose uptake inhibitor SgrT", sgrR. named 93-94% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 74 (sgrR), named 93%, 0.40 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 75-79 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 71-89%, all P, RGP 3%. named 95-97% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 75, named 95%, 0.23 bits.
